prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Liberty, Missouri (north of Kansas City)? And is this for a home (residential) or a business (commercial)? I can either give general guidance now or, if you want, compile a short list of nearby testers — I’ll just need the ZIP or permission to use web-search terms you can paste into Google/Maps (I can’t perform live web searches from here).

Quick guidance so you can find and hire someone right away:

Where to look
- Call the City of Liberty Water Department / Public Works — many cities keep a list of certified backflow testers who are permitted to file test results with the city.
- Search Google Maps / Yelp / Angi / HomeAdvisor for “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow assembly tester Kansas City metro.”
- Check with local plumbing companies, irrigation/sprinkler companies, or commercial plumbing contractors — they commonly perform testing and repairs.

What to ask/verify
- Are you a certified backflow tester? (Ask to see certificate/ID.)
- Will you file the test report with the City of Liberty (or supply the form I can submit)?
- Can you repair and re-test the assembly the same day if needed?
- Do you carry liability insurance and provide a written test report?
- Warranty on parts/labor and an estimate for common repairs.

Typical costs (rough ranges)
- Test only: ~$50–$150 (depends on complexity and location).
- Repairs: highly variable — small parts/valves might be $75–$300+, complete assembly replacement is several hundred dollars or more. Ask for an estimate before work.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a ready-made Google Maps search phrase and phone/email script you can use to contact testers.
- Try to list several nearby companies if you give me your ZIP code or allow me to run a search (note: I can’t perform live web searches from here, but I can tell you exactly what to look for and how to check credentials).

Which would you prefer?
